edits.content:
-- Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day. One row per day per activity, for every day asked
-- for (release day, the weeks before it and the weeks after it), with the same weekday a week
-- earlier beside it (a date join, not a row offset, so a missing day cannot shift the pairing).
{%- set release_day = var('github_release_day') %}
with daily as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_github__daily_counts') }}
)

select
    md5(daily.activity || '|' || cast(daily.activity_date as varchar)) as github_day_key,
    daily.activity_date,
    daily.activity,
    case daily.activity
        when 'prs_opened' then 'PRs opened'
        when 'prs_merged' then 'PRs merged'
        when 'commits' then 'Commits'
        else daily.activity
    end as activity_label,
    daily.activity_count,
    daily.is_available,
    dayname(daily.activity_date) as weekday_name,
    daily.activity_date = date '{{ release_day }}' as is_release_day,
    cast(date_diff('day', date '{{ release_day }}', daily.activity_date) as integer)
        as days_from_release,
    daily.observed_at,
    week_before.activity_count as prior_week_count,
    case
        when daily.activity_count is not null and week_before.activity_count > 0
            then 100 * (daily.activity_count / week_before.activity_count - 1)
    end as wow_pct_change
from daily
left join daily as week_before
    on daily.activity = week_before.activity
    and week_before.activity_date = cast(daily.activity_date - 7 as date)

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_github_daily
  description: 'Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day, one row per day per activity.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - activity_date
        - activity
        population:
          rule: 'Every (day, activity) row in staging: 1 Oct 2026 onward, only fully ended UTC days.'
          parent:
            model: stg_github__daily_counts
            key:
              activity_date: activity_date
              activity: activity
        assumptions:
        - decision: What 'GitHub activity' counts
          chosen: PRs opened, PRs merged, commits (GitHub Search API total_count)
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: metric 4 is GitHub PRs / commits; docs/metrics.md names the Search API `is:pr
            created:<day>`'
          column: activity
        - decision: Day boundary
          chosen: UTC day, first to last second
          evidence: contract
          detail: 'config.py: all days in this study are UTC days'
          column: activity_date
        - decision: Week-on-week pairing
          chosen: same activity, same weekday 7 calendar days earlier (date join); NULL when either day
            is missing
          evidence: request
          column: wow_pct_change
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: add the previous Thursdays as context and highlight the drop; the headline
            compares with the Thursday before the same way'
  columns:
  - name: github_day_key
    description: md5 of activity|day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activity_date
    description: UTC day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: time
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activity
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activity_label
    description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activity_count
    description: How many on the day. NULL when unavailable, never zero.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero. Never add across activities.
          aggregation: sum
          additivity: additive
          unit: count
  - name: is_available
    description: True when the day's count is complete.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: weekday_name
    description: Day of the week.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: is_release_day
    description: True on GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: days_from_release
    description: Days after release day (negative before it).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: observed_at
    description: When the count was asked for (UTC).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: prior_week_count
    description: The same activity on the same weekday a week earlier. NULL when that day was not counted.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL when the week-earlier day has no count.
  - name: wow_pct_change
    description: The day against the same weekday a week earlier, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL unless both days have a count and the week before is above zero.
unit_tests:
- name: github_week_on_week_pairs_the_same_weekday
  description: Each day is set against the same weekday 7 days earlier, per activity; the day before or
    another activity never pairs.
  model: fct_github_daily
  overrides:
    vars:
      github_release_day: '2026-11-19'
  given:
  - input: ref('stg_github__daily_counts')
    rows:
    - activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity: prs_opened
      activity_count: 1000
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q prs_opened 2026-11-12
    - activity_date: '2026-11-18'
      activity: prs_opened
      activity_count: 9999
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q prs_opened 2026-11-18
    - activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity: prs_opened
      activity_count: 750
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q prs_opened 2026-11-19
    - activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity: commits
      activity_count: 50
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q commits 2026-11-12
  expect:
    rows:
    - activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity: prs_opened
      prior_week_count: null
      wow_pct_change: null
    - activity_date: '2026-11-18'
      activity: prs_opened
      prior_week_count: null
      wow_pct_change: null
    - activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity: prs_opened
      prior_week_count: 1000
      wow_pct_change: -25.0
    - activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity: commits
      prior_week_count: null
      wow_pct_change: null
- name: github_week_on_week_null_when_either_day_is_missing
  description: A NULL count on either day leaves the change NULL, never -100%; a zero week before has
    no percent change.
  model: fct_github_daily
  overrides:
    vars:
      github_release_day: '2026-11-19'
  given:
  - input: ref('stg_github__daily_counts')
    rows:
    - activity_date: '2026-11-05'
      activity: prs_opened
      activity_count: null
      is_available: false
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q prs_opened 2026-11-05
    - activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity: prs_opened
      activity_count: 1000
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q prs_opened 2026-11-12
    - activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity: prs_opened
      activity_count: null
      is_available: false
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q prs_opened 2026-11-19
    - activity_date: '2026-10-29'
      activity: prs_opened
      activity_count: 0
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q prs_opened 2026-10-29
    - activity_date: '2026-11-05'
      activity: commits
      activity_count: 5
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q commits 2026-11-05
    - activity_date: '2026-10-29'
      activity: commits
      activity_count: 0
      is_available: true
      observed_at: '2026-11-20 09:00:00'
      endpoint: issues
      query: q commits 2026-10-29
  expect:
    rows:
    - activity_date: '2026-11-05'
      activity: prs_opened
      prior_week_count: 0
      wow_pct_change: null
    - activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity: prs_opened
      prior_week_count: null
      wow_pct_change: null
    - activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity: prs_opened
      prior_week_count: 1000
      wow_pct_change: null
    - activity_date: '2026-10-29'
      activity: prs_opened
      prior_week_count: null
      wow_pct_change: null
    - activity_date: '2026-11-05'
      activity: commits
      prior_week_count: 0
      wow_pct_change: null
    - activity_date: '2026-10-29'
      activity: commits
      prior_week_count: null
      wow_pct_change: null
